info.description:
### 📘 Account Service API
Provides wallet and ledger operations. It owns user and system accounts, balance mutations, transaction journaling, deposit and withdrawal request flows, transfer flows, blockchain transaction tracking, balance history snapshots, and related event publishing.
### 🔑 Authentication
Some endpoints require an **Authorization** header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
